commit.message: fix(replays): improve sentry tracing (#41480) - manage our own transaction stop and starting since we're using a threadpool. The docs also suggest to do this manually: https://docs.sentry.io/platforms/python/troubleshooting/ - re-organize our spans a bit. This appears to give us better traces, especially in our store function (tested locally):
